description: This file defines a validation rule class 'InAccessibleEmpNumbers' within the OrangeHRM system, used to check if an employee number is accessible based on user role and authorization context.

classes.name: InAccessibleEmpNumbers
classes.description: A validation rule class that determines if a given employee number is accessible based on user roles and authorization settings.

properties.name: includeLoggedInEmpNumber
properties.description: Flag to indicate if the logged-in employee's number should be considered accessible.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the rule with whether to include the logged-in employee number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the input employee number is accessible based on role permissions and the includeLoggedInEmpNumber flag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with an optional flag to include the logged-in employee number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to check if the employee number is accessible.
